svg.title: Recall@10 differences were within noise
svg.desc: A horizontal forest plot of two paired Recall@10 differences against the hybrid baseline over 29 queries with 10,000 bootstrap resamples. Dense minus Hybrid is +0.034 (95% CI −0.069 to +0.121); Lexical minus Hybrid is +0.023 (95% CI −0.069 to +0.126). Both confidence intervals cross the zero line, so the aggregate Recall@10 ranking is not defensible at this sample size.
